task: Implement MoMorph screen MaZUn5xHXZ ("Sun* Kudos - Live board", 64 design items, 41 test cases) as the public route /kudos. First screen in this repo backed by real mutable data: migration 0006 introduces the kudos tables, a card view, and a department column on users. Scope is the board itself plus every interaction contained entirely within this frame (highlight carousel, hashtag/department filters, heart toggle, copy link, infinite scroll, spotlight scatter, sidebar stats). Five behaviors whose target frames do not exist yet are deferred with honest rendering: the Viet Kudo dialog, the Secret Box dialog, the kudo detail page, the profile hover preview, and the image lightbox.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /kudos returns 200 for an anonymous visitor, asserted by kudos.spec.ts C01; this also retires the five hardcoded href="/kudos" links that pointed at a 404 route
Banner A renders the title 'Hệ thống ghi nhận lời cảm ơn' and the SAA 2025 KUDOS logo, non-interactive
Input pill A.1 renders the exact placeholder 'Hôm nay, bạn muốn gửi lời cảm ơn và ghi nhận đến ai?' with the pencil icon on the left
HIGHLIGHT carousel shows the 5 kudos with the most hearts; prev is disabled on slide 1, next is disabled on slide 5, pagination reads x/5
Hashtag and Phòng ban filters narrow both the carousel and the ALL KUDOS feed together, and reset carousel pagination to 1
Clicking a hashtag on any card sets the hashtag filter to that tag
ALL KUDOS feed loads further pages on scroll without a full navigation
Empty feed renders the exact string 'Hiện tại chưa có Kudos nào.'
Empty sidebar leaderboard renders the exact string 'Chưa có dữ liệu'
Copy Link writes the kudo URL to the clipboard and shows the toast 'Link copied — ready to share!'
Heart toggle: one heart per user per kudo, the kudo's own sender cannot heart it, un-hearting revokes exactly what was credited
An anonymous visitor sees the heart button rendered but disabled
Spotlight renders recipient names plus a live total count sourced from the database, and the Sunner search input caps at 100 characters
Sidebar renders the 5 statistic rows and both 10-Sunner lists
Seeded content is transcribed from the Figma frame, with no invented names, messages, hashtags or numbers
blastRadius: five entry points hardcoded href="/kudos" while the route 404'd; tests/e2e/standards.spec.ts C12 documented that 404 in its own DOM contract and needed updating once the route existed
adding a department column to the users table touches a table populated by the auth trigger from migration 0002, so the column must be nullable
messages/{vi,en}.json are covered by messages-parity.test.ts, which asserts the two bundles stay structurally identical

a new kudos card view exposes sender and receiver display names, so the REVOKE ALL before GRANT pattern from 0005_profile_cards_view.sql must be repeated or anon gains full table privileges by Supabase default
the heart action credits the sender's account, which is the same counter the profile page statistics card reads, so F006 surfaces change from 0 to real values
contracts: tests/e2e/kudos.spec.ts is the single DOM contract for the UI phases and must be red on a real assertion failure before any UI code is written (test policy e2e-red-first)
MoMorph design frames are authoritative: a node's character is the content, itemName is only the designer's layer label
MoMorph rule: use Figma design content as the mock data source, do not invent data
plans/260907-1725-kudos-live-board/clarifications.md is authoritative for every scope decision and is not re-litigated
eslint.config.mjs no-restricted-imports forbids importing another route segment's _shared, so shared copy stays in src/app/_shared
supabase/migrations/0005_profile_cards_view.sql sets the RLS precedent: ENABLE plus FORCE, REVOKE ALL before GRANT
